picks.file: Giuseppe Berlendis, Veduta della Porta Sant'Agostino in Bergamo.jpg
picks.what: Porta Sant’Agostino and the upper town, colored print
picks.why: color view of the Venetian walls, the gate and the upper town with San Vigilio castle; caption trimmed

picks.what: Porta Nuova and the upper town, wood engraving in Le Cento Città d’Italia
picks.why: classic view of the Porta Nuova tollhouses with the walled upper town above; high resolution

picks.what: The upper town and the plain from San Vigilio, photograph
picks.why: upper town towers seen from San Vigilio with the lower city beyond; very wide panorama trimmed to its left half

gaps: P0–P2: nothing of Bergamo; P5: nothing
notes: #1–#4 and #8 are not Bergamo (a Nuremberg Chronicle portrait of Alexander of Bergamo and Venetian/capriccio paintings held in the Accademia Carrara). #5 (Berlendis, Lazzaretto view) is dated only “before 1833”. #12 (about 1870 photo from San Vigilio) is a good alternative for P4 but low resolution (1024 px) and too close in date to #11 for a second P4 view.
